paper_metadata.title: Large Dual-Lumen Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation Cannulas Are Associated with More Intracranial Hemorrhage

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study uses a large, well-established international registry (ELSO) and provides clear inclusion/exclusion criteria. While it is a retrospective registry study, the baseline characteristics are extensively described and the sample size is large enough to be representative of the target clinical population.

items.evidence_snippet: The extracorporeal life support organization (ELSO) registry was queried to identify all adult patients who had VV ECMO between 2011 and 2016 and had either a 27 or 31 French dual-lumen VV ECMO cannula.
items.reasoning: The source is a major international registry, and the population is defined by age (adults), procedure (VV ECMO), and specific device exposure.

Furthermore, the diagnosis of ICH in ECMO patients often requires imaging which may not be performed uniformly across all centers, potentially leading to detection bias.
